params.name: filter
params.description:

`documentNumber`: *equals*, *notEquals*, *in*, *notIn*, *contains*, *notContains*, *startsWith*, *endsWith*

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort via id, -id, documentNumber, -documentNumber, documentDate, -documentDate, customerNumber, -customerNumber, documentAddress.country, -documentAddress.country, project.id, -project.id, createdAt, -createdAt, updatedAt and -updatedAt. Default sort is id

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of items per page. Default: 15, Max: 1000

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. Only used with simple and table pagination.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor to use for the paginated call. Only used with cursor pagination. Not compatible with page parameter
